angle.hook: Cities: Skylines II is free to play on Steam until Mon 16 Nov 22:00 Dubai, and 30% off (AED 133.70) until 19 Nov
angle.why_now: The Steam store page shows the free play window from Thu 12 Nov 22:00 to Mon 16 Nov 22:00 Dubai and the weekend deal to 19 Nov; Paradox announced the Park Adventures expansion on 10 Nov
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf PC players can try the city builder free this weekend; the UAE store shows AED 133.70 after the discount (AED 191.00 normal); Arabic is not among the Steam languages
angle.payoff: free until Monday 22:00 Dubai, 30% off to 19 Nov, Park Adventures on 2 Dec
